generations.text: Nadia Haddad contacted support because the Strata Mini fails to wake from sleep since 2026-01-28. It is a High priority case and the status is currently Escalated. The agent offered a repair of $120.00. The knowledge base notes that Strata Mini rear-tray jams clear with the 3-step reset. The customer was told a firmware update would arrive on 2026-03-07.
